title: Ensure LXD is stopped before MicroCeph and MicroOVN and their sub-units
description:
### Please confirm

- [x] I have searched existing issues to check if an issue already exists for the bug I encountered.

### Distribution

Ubuntu

### Distribution version

Noble

### Output of `snap list --all lxd core20 core22 core24 snapd`

```shell
N/A
```

### System info

N/A

### Instance log

N/A

### Expected behavior

LXD is stopped before *all* of MicroCeph's services.

### Actual behavior

We have seen cases where LXD is stopped after some of MicroCeph's services have stopped.

This workaround was previously tried https://github.com/canonical/lxd-pkg-snap/pull/710

But looks like we need to also make sure LXD stops before the sub-units:

```
$ snap info microceph
...
services:
  microceph.cephfs-mirror: simple, disabled, inactive
  microceph.daemon:        simple, enabled, active
  microceph.log-rotate:    oneshot, enabled, inactive
  microceph.mds:           simple, disabled, inactive
  microceph.mgr:           simple, disabled, inactive
  microceph.mon:           simple, disabled, inactive
  microceph.nfs:           simple, disabled, inactive
  microceph.osd:           simple, disabled, inactive
  microceph.rbd-mirror:    simple, disabled, inactive
  microceph.rgw:           simple, disabled, inactive
```

```
snap info microovn
...
services:
  microovn.chassis:                simple, disabled, inactive
  microovn.daemon:                 simple, enabled, active
  microovn.ovn-northd:             simple, disabled, inactive
  microovn.ovn-ovsdb-server-nb:    simple, disabled, inactive
  microovn.ovn-ovsdb-server-sb:    simple, disabled, inactive
  microovn.refresh-expiring-certs: oneshot, enabled, inactive
  microovn.switch:                 simple, disabled, inactive
```

N/A
